calibration.setup: isig[0.3:3.0], lines Mg_Ka Al_Ka Si_Ka, create_model(auto_background=True, auto_add_lines=True), fit, then calibrate_energy_axis(mode, xray_lines); model energy_resolution_MnKa 130; offsets/scales are those of the CROPPED axis (its offset is the first kept channel's energy)

e2.layout: table line energies (names in line_names), then 3 values per channel midpoint (-1e-13, 0, +1e-13) for k = 0..4094, then the ends

big_pool.what: no fixture: the Swift test builds this pool; all values exact in Double (< 2^53)

intensity.settings: R_MnKa 130, integration factor 2.0, merged background windows from estimate_background_windows(xray_lines=all three)

near.order_note: exSpy order of exactly tied |dE| lines varies between processes (hash-ordered element dict); lines are in canonical order (|dE|, name)

peaks.setting_defaults: peakgroup 10, subchannel True; 'default' = amp_thresh None (10 % of max), medfilt_radius 5
